$comment: every key of SLSsteam's config.yaml (37, checked 2026-09-28 against a private AceSLS/SLSsteam build's own bundled res/config.yaml + its runtime 'Config loading issues' log - it reads AdditionalDepots/AdditionalPackages/DecryptionKeys/CloudProxies/InventoryItems even though an earlier audit against the public main branch's history said the first three never existed; trust the running build's own bundled template over a stale history read if they ever disagree again). `removed` is keys SLSsteam doesn't read anymore or never had: paws warns if your config still has them and never writes them.

DisableFamilyShareLock.desc: turns off family share license locking, for you and for others

UseWhitelist.desc: AppIds becomes a whitelist instead of the usual blacklist

AppIds.desc: apps to leave out or put in. a game's AppId covers all its DLC

AdditionalApps.desc: apps to inject. overrides OwnerIds for shared apps and BREAKS downloads, so only use it for games not in your library

AdditionalDepots.desc: extra depot ids to inject, used for downloading together with AdditionalApps

AdditionalPackages.desc: extra licenses to inject. only works with store packages

DlcData.desc: extra DLC names, only needed when a game runs into steam's 64 DLC limit

AppTokens.desc: tokens SLSsteam uses to get product info from steam for some games

CDKeys.desc: old CD keys some games want. if you don't set one SLSsteam makes one up from your accountId + appId

FakeOffline.desc: makes steam look offline for these apps

FakeAppIds.desc: swap an app's AppId so networking works. key 0 = every app you don't own. one app per fake id at a time! most people use 480 (Spacewar) so they land with the Online-Fix crowd. games on SteamNetworkingSockets also need a cert patch (search "SLSsteam SteamNetworkingSockets Patch"), skip that if the game has anti-cheat

ManifestIds.desc: pin a depot to a manifest: old game versions, or lock a game to one version

DepotBlacklist.desc: depots to never download (fixes the Saints Row IV Proton downloads for example)

CloudProxies.desc: redirects cloud saves for unowned apps to the given appid. key 0 = every app you don't own

IdleStatus.desc: custom in-game status. AppId 0 turns it off

GameTitles.desc: rename games. only works for apps you own

DenuvoGames.desc: stops a game from unlocking on the wrong account. the key is a 64-bit SteamId

SteamIdOverride.desc: the SteamId an app gets to see. 0 = the one in the cached AppOwnershipTicket

SmartTickets.desc: smarter SteamId spoofing by looking at the exe that just connected. SteamDRM=0x1, Denuvo=0x2

MaxSchemaTries.desc: grabs achievement schemas from steam's CDN by itself. 0 turns it off (use tools/schema-grabber)

LaunchOptions.desc: change the launch command in SpawnGame, %command% works. 4294967294 = all apps you don't own, 4294967295 = all apps

SafeMode.desc: turns SLSsteam off when steamclient.so has a hash it doesn't know. good for steam deck gamemode

WarnHashMissmatch.desc: pops a notification when steamclient.so's hash isn't a known safe one

NotifyInit.desc: pops a notification once SLSsteam has started

API.desc: lets you send commands through /tmp/SLSsteam.API (install, uninstall, compat, reloadlua)

Plugins.desc: loads lua plugins from the plugins folder. they run whatever code they want, only trust ones you know

DisableCloud.desc: no cloud saves for unlocked games. set it to no if you use CloudRedirect

DisableUpdates.desc: no updates for AdditionalApps and games you don't own. games you own use ManifestIds

FakeName.desc: changes your profile name, on your side only

FakeEmail.desc: changes your email, on your side only (shows as verified)

FakeWalletBalance.desc: changes your wallet balance, on your side only. 0 turns it off

LogLevels.desc: what gets logged, as a bitmask: Trace=0x1 Once=0x2 Debug=0x4 Warn=0x8 Error=0x10 Info=0x20 NotifyShort=0x40 NotifyLong=0x80

DumpClientInterfaces.desc: dumps every IClientInterfaceMap it uses (for debugging)

ExtendedLogging.desc: logs every Steamworks call. the log gets huge, debugging only
